title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-aisha-khan
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - console / observability
Owner: Aisha Khan
Date: 2026-03-02 (last updated)

Quick context / goals:
- Centralize today's triage items for console dashboards, customer-reported anomalies, and follow-ups.
- Triage severity, reproduce, assign owners, and decide on immediate mitigation vs. next-cycle fix.

Top items (high priority)
1) Customer: Acme Corp - dashboard X missing tiles / 500 errors (JIRA-CI-2345)
   - Reported via support ticket (SUP-9876) and Slack thread #cs-acme.
   - Symptoms: When switching time range to >24h on "Model Latency by Route" dashboard, several panels return 500 / JSON parse errors. Intermittent (3/10 reloads).
   - Repro steps I ran:
     * Login as acme-dev (impersonation) -> Open Console -> Observability -> Model Latency by Route -> change range to 7d -> click refresh.
     * Observed 500 in network tab: /api/observability/query?range=7d&panel=latency-by-route
     * Replicated locally with query id q-987 (see below).
   - Quick checks done:
     * Dashboard query returned very large aggregation (high cardinality routes) -> backend timed out (30s).
     * Temporary mitigation: increased query timeout to 45s for the API route in dev, reproduced fix. Not ideal for prod.
     * Noted that KV cache for prefix queries is cold for large ranges.
   - Possible root causes:
     * Unbounded GROUP BY across dynamic route tag (high cardinality) + unchanged default max_buckets on analytics store.
     * Recent change in kernel selection for quantized metrics pipeline (PR #512) may have impacted internal timeouts.
   - Next actions / owners:
     * Assign to Samira for deeper query optimization and limit enforcement (owner: Samira Gupta, ETA 2d).
     * Riley to coordinate with SRE to check query timeout/lethargy at infra layer (owner: Riley Park).
     * I (Aisha) to draft customer reply with workaround and ETA.

Customer reply draft:
Hi <Customer Rep>,

Thanks for the report — we can reproduce the 500s when selecting ranges larger than 24h for the "Model Latency by Route" dashboard. We identified that a high-cardinality aggregation is timing out for large ranges. As a short-term workaround, use the pre-set ranges (24h / 72h) or apply a route filter to reduce cardinality; we can also enable a temporary higher timeout while we implement a safer fix.

Next steps we are doing for you:
- Query optimization and hard limits to prevent unbounded GROUP BYs (ETA ~2 business days).
- Infrastructure timeout review with SRE to identify whether a route-level timeout increase is safe.
- We'll follow up with a definitive ETA and plan by EOD.

Apologies for the disruption and thanks for the patience.

Regards,
Aisha (Observability)

---
2) Dashboard: "Model Errors by Model" - empty chart for several customers (intermittent) (JIRA-CI-2378)
   - Symptoms: Empty series when viewing last 7d, but raw metrics exist in the store. Appears for customers with multi-region deployments.
   - Quick hypothesis: Timezone offset / bucket alignment bug in rollup job introduced 2026-02-18 (deploy).
   - Repro: Compare raw metrics query vs. dashboard aggregated query for same time window for tenant t-421.
   - Action: Samira to reproduce and file infra rollup job issue if confirmed.

3) Internal: Alert storm on dashboard rendering service around 2026-03-01 14:12 UTC
   - Symptoms: Rendering worker queue backlog spikes, CPU bound, downstream 502s on tile rendering.
   - Temp mitigation: scaled up render pool by 2x in k8s autoscaler.
   - Follow-up: Riley / SRE to investigate memory leak in renderer (heap growth observed).

Lower priority / backlog notes:
- Investigate adding server-side pre-aggregation for common queries (routes, models) to avoid high-cardinality live aggregations.
- Consider UI change: warn when selecting >24h range on high-cardinality dashboards with suggested filters.
- Dashboard test: add synthetic load test that hits multi-tenant large-range queries.

Notes / logs / query refs:
- Local query id q-987 (attached to JIRA-CI-2345).
- Rollup job deploy: deploy-2026-02-18 (tag: metrics-rollup-v1.3.0).
- PR suspected: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/512 (kernel selection change).
- Support thread: SUP-9876 (CS).

Immediate todo (today):
- [ ] Send customer reply (Aisha) - today
- [ ] Assign query optimization ticket to Samira (Aisha -> Samira) - today
- [ ] SRE infra timeout check (Riley) - today
- [ ] Add synthetic test case to dashboard testplan (Aisha / QE) - this week

Questions / open items:
- Is there a safe default aggregation cap we can enforce globally without breaking legitimate dashboards? (Samira to propose)
- Does render pool memory leak correlate with a specific tenant payload size? (Riley to correlate logs)

References:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/infr/console-triage-notes
- JIRA: JIRA-CI-2345, JIRA-CI-2378
- Slack: #cs-acme, #obs-triage

Scratchpad notes (freeform)
- Might consider adding route cardinality sampling in the analytics store to early-detect dangerously high groups.
- If we implement UI warning, coordinate with DX to create copy and an opt-out for power users.

-- end of scratchpad --
